description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) I was wondering if there was a way to get a question answered for me regarding grounds for divorce. There are many men who struggle with porn addiction and some wives consider this as "fornication" and a reason for divorce, is this biblically sound? also, does Paul seem to say in 1 Cor. 7:15 that the believing spouse is freed from the marriage bond if the unbelieving spouse abandoned them? I am very curious what Pastor Bohr's response to these things is. Please, Thanks.
.
2.) "What's your view on the timing of the 'edges' of the Sabbath? 
According to Lev. 23:32, ""...from the evening...until the evening.""
Having in mind the different time zones and also, long days, and short time periods, how can we all be certain of the time when the Sabbath begins, especially the days when it's past 6pm but the sun has not yet set and vice versa? What's the problem for a defined zone to use 6:00pm to avoid all these discrepancies?"
.
.
.
